text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Spanish Foreign Minister Abel Matutes tells visiting Crown Prince Mohamed "Morocco's political openness will ensure our stability and security".
- Prime Minister Abdellatif Filali stresses need to reform administration for more efficiency regarding investments and employment.
- Some of the 130 jobless graduates on hunger strike since early this month, taken to hospital.
- Islamic Development Bank grants Morocco a $30 million loan to buy crude oil.
- Arab Maghreb Union (AMU) decision to cut staff to five from 15 is result of members' failure to overcome differences.
